title: Too small to be useful
text: Too small to be useful. After receiving this I really thought about if I installed it, I would be taking up more space than I’m gaining. It doesn’t hold very much. The unit slides out as 1 piece, not independent drawers. You’ll probably need a liner in the bottom so your small items like vanilla extract for example, don’t slip through the wire. It’s made with solid craftsmanship and all the hardware is included. Just really think about how teeeny this is and if it would enhance your space before ordering

product_metadata.title: Tiger Pull Out Drawer Organizer, Double Tier Shelves 12" W x 18" D x 16"H, Great for Vanities Under Sink, Perfect for 15" Wide Cabinet Or More
features: 【Convenient Access】 With a double tier shelf, your items are easily accessible and organized, making it simple to find what you need without having to search through a cluttered cabinet.
【Increased Storage Space】The double tier shelf provides an additional layer of storage space in your vanity cabinet, allowing you to store more items without taking up additional room.

【Easy to Install】Vanity double tier shelves are usually easy to install and require no special tools or skills. Simply place the shelf in your vanity cabinet and adjust it as necessary to fit your needs.

【Versatile Storage】 Vanity double tier shelves come in a variety of sizes and designs, making it easy to find a shelf that fits your specific needs. You can use them to store makeup, skincare products, hair care items, and more.

【Cost-effective】 Vanity double tier shelves are a cost-effective way to organize your vanity cabinet. They are usually affordable and can save you money in the long run by helping you avoid purchasing additional storage containers.
